stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Leaves float on the surface of the pond.
items.sentenceZh: 叶子漂浮在池塘水面上。
items.scene: A calm pond is viewed at a low angle, with several autumn leaves and one lily pad floating exactly where air meets water. Their reflections and gentle circular ripples make the horizontal water surface unmistakable, while fish remain visibly below it.
items.altText: 秋叶和睡莲叶漂在平静池塘表面，水下可见游鱼。

items.sentenceEn: The purpose of the ramp is to make the entrance accessible.
items.sentenceZh: 这条坡道的用途是让入口便于通行。
items.scene: An adult wheelchair user moves independently up a gently sloped entrance ramp toward an open public-building door while stairs sit beside it. The direct functional relationship between ramp and accessible entrance clearly communicates purpose.
items.altText: 轮椅使用者沿缓坡进入公共建筑，旁边同时可见台阶。

items.sentenceEn: Tiny plants can exist in the driest places.
items.sentenceZh: 微小的植物也能存在于最干旱的地方。
items.scene: In a vast dry cracked landscape, one small living green plant emerges from a narrow crevice, with fresh leaves and roots finding a trace of moisture. Its vivid presence against the barren surroundings communicates existence and survival.
items.altText: 一株鲜活小植物从广阔干裂土地的缝隙中长出。

items.sentenceEn: The rug has a repeating geometric pattern.
items.sentenceZh: 这张地毯有重复的几何图案。
items.scene: A handwoven rug fills most of the frame with a clearly repeating sequence of diamonds, stripes and small leaf shapes in orderly rows. An adult artisan continues weaving the same visual sequence at a loom.
items.altText: 手织地毯上菱形、条纹和叶形元素按规则重复排列。

items.sentenceEn: She is the teacher whom the students came to thank.
items.sentenceZh: 她就是学生们前来感谢的那位老师。
items.scene: Three adult students direct their thanks toward one clearly central teacher, offering a small bouquet and a handmade blank card while she receives them warmly. Gaze, gesture and the transfer of gifts make the teacher the recipient of the action.
items.altText: 三名成年学生把花束和空白卡片送给中央的老师并向她致谢。

items.sentenceEn: She protects her skin with sunscreen.
items.sentenceZh: 她用防晒霜保护皮肤。
items.scene: An adult outdoors applies a visible streak of sunscreen along one forearm beneath a sun hat and rolled sleeve. The illustrated arm, hand and protective lotion are the clear focus, with natural non-photographic skin texture and no medical symptoms.
items.altText: 户外成年人把防晒霜均匀涂在裸露前臂皮肤上。

items.sentenceEn: The agent shows the apartment to two clients.
items.sentenceZh: 代理人带两位客户参观公寓。
items.scene: A professional adult property agent holds a plain key ring and opens an empty apartment door for two adult clients, then gestures toward the rooms with a simple floor-plan sheet that contains no readable text.
items.altText: 房产代理人拿着钥匙，为两位客户打开空公寓并介绍房间。

items.sentenceEn: The dog's owner clips on its leash.
items.sentenceZh: 狗主人给它扣上牵引绳。
items.scene: One adult kneels beside a familiar happy dog, fastening the dog's leash to its collar while holding a small treat pouch and water bowl. Their comfortable mutual attention makes the caring ownership relationship clear.
items.altText: 狗主人蹲下给熟悉的狗扣好牵引绳，人与狗互相注视。

items.sentenceEn: The machine shapes flat metal into bowls.
items.sentenceZh: 这台机器把平整金属加工成碗。
items.scene: One large workshop machine with visible gears, rollers, lever and guarded press transforms a flat metal disc into a shallow bowl. An adult operator stands at a safe control handle, and input disc plus finished bowl clarify the machine's work.
items.altText: 带齿轮、滚轮和防护压头的机器把平金属片加工成浅碗。

items.sentenceEn: Gas from the flask fills the balloon.
items.sentenceZh: 烧瓶里的气体充满了气球。
items.scene: A safe tabletop science setup shows a transparent flask producing many visible bubbles, connected directly to one balloon stretched over its neck. The balloon is inflated by the otherwise invisible gas, with no flame, labels or readable text.
items.altText: 透明烧瓶内产生气泡，气体通过瓶口把上方气球充起。

items.sentenceEn: One cyclist rides ahead of the group.
items.sentenceZh: 一名骑行者骑在队伍前面。
items.scene: On one curving countryside path, a lead adult cyclist is clearly farther forward in the direction of travel while three other cyclists follow at a safe distance behind. All wear helmets, and spatial depth makes ahead unmistakable.
items.altText: 乡间弯道上一名骑行者明显位于前方，三名同伴在后方跟随。

items.sentenceEn: Three generations plant a tree together.
items.sentenceZh: 祖孙三代一起种下一棵树。
items.scene: Exactly three generations of one family work together around a young tree: two older grandparents steady the sapling, their adult child adds soil, and one school-age grandchild waters it. Age relationships are visually clear and affectionate.
items.altText: 祖父母、成年子女和一名孙辈三代人共同种下一棵小树。

items.sentenceEn: The ground floor is used for commercial activity.
items.sentenceZh: 一楼用于商业活动。
items.scene: The ground floor of an urban building contains several active small businesses: a bakery counter, repair shop and produce stall with customers exchanging goods and payments. Upper floors are quiet apartments, clearly contrasting commercial and residential use without signs.
items.altText: 城市建筑一楼的面包店、维修铺和果蔬摊正在进行商品交易。

items.sentenceEn: She addresses the neighborhood meeting.
items.sentenceZh: 她在社区会议上向居民讲话。
items.scene: An adult community organizer stands at the front of a modest meeting room, speaking directly to seated neighbors with an open-hand gesture. The audience faces her attentively, and a blank display board supports the public-address context.
items.altText: 社区组织者站在会议室前方向邻居讲话，听众面向她专注聆听。

items.sentenceEn: Researchers study cancer cells in the laboratory.
items.sentenceZh: 研究人员在实验室研究癌细胞。
items.scene: Two adult biomedical researchers safely examine cultured cells in a modern laboratory. A microscope connects to a screen showing a clean non-graphic field of ordinary cells beside a small irregular cluster under study. No patient, diagnosis claim, body organ or alarming imagery.
items.altText: 两名研究人员在实验室通过显微镜观察培养细胞中的异常细胞群。

items.sentenceEn: The cashier scans each item separately.
items.sentenceZh: 收银员逐件扫描每件商品。
items.scene: At a grocery checkout, an adult cashier holds exactly one plain jar over a scanner while several distinct groceries wait in a neat line on the belt and already scanned goods sit beyond. The jar is clearly one discrete item.
items.altText: 收银员把一个罐子单独放到扫描器上，其他商品整齐排队等待。

items.sentenceEn: She removes the headset and returns to reality.
items.sentenceZh: 她摘下头显，回到现实。
items.scene: An adult lowers a virtual-reality headset and looks around her ordinary living room, where a sofa, houseplant and window are solid and sharply rendered. Faint translucent fragments of an imagined underwater world dissolve harmlessly around the raised headset.
items.altText: 成年人摘下虚拟现实头显，清晰的客厅出现，虚幻海底景象正在消散。

items.sentenceEn: The coach demonstrates the passing drill.
items.sentenceZh: 教练示范传球训练。
items.scene: An adult sports coach at the edge of a practice field demonstrates a ball-passing movement between two cones while a diverse adult team watches and prepares to copy the drill. A whistle and tactics board with no readable text reinforce the role.
items.altText: 运动教练在训练场用球和标志桶示范传球动作，成年队员认真观看。

items.sentenceEn: The students greet Mrs Chen each morning.
items.sentenceZh: 学生们每天早晨向陈夫人问好。
items.scene: At a school entrance in the morning, two students politely greet an adult married teacher as she welcomes them. A simple wedding band is visible on her hand as she waves, but the scene remains a natural respectful greeting with no written names or titles.
items.altText: 校门口两名学生向一位戴婚戒的成年女教师问好，她微笑挥手回应。

items.sentenceEn: They grow vegetables in the yard.
items.sentenceZh: 他们在院子里种蔬菜。
items.scene: A fenced yard directly behind a modest house contains raised vegetable beds, a small lawn, watering can and garden tools. Two adults tend tomatoes and leafy greens, with the enclosing fence and house relationship making the yard clear.
items.altText: 房屋后方围栏围起的院子里有草坪和菜畦，两名成年人正在照料蔬菜。
